channel.description: This is a randomly ordered feed of the most recent entries from summarizedStoriesMainNLscienceAndDiscovery, skipping any feeds with errors.

item.title: Brain's evolutionary wiring may hinder weight loss
item.description: Research suggests the brain is programmed to defend body fat, making weight loss harder than a simple test of willpower.

item.title: Taiwan expedition uncovers hidden forest of giant trees
item.description: In Taiwan's remote mountains, scientists discovered a pristine forest with hundreds of giant Taiwania firs after years of challenging expeditions.

item.title: Newly discovered beetles named after One Piece character Luffy
item.description: A new genus of beetles has been named Luffy, after the stretchy protagonist of the anime One Piece, due to their unusual elongated bodies.

item.title: NSF launches two Materials Innovation Platforms with $50M
item.description: The U.S. National Science Foundation is investing $50 million in research infrastructure to accelerate the discovery and development of advanced materials.
